title.value: Joint Bayesian Inference of Graphical Structure and Parameters with a Single Generative Flow Network
title.justification: The paper is based on the usage and advancements of Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) to approximate the joint posterior distribution over DAG structures and their parameters using a model called JSP-GFN (Joint Structure and Parameters GFlowNet), as indicated by the abstract and introduction sections.
title.quote: We propose to infer the joint posterior over graphical structures G and parameters of the conditional probability distributions θ of a Bayesian Network using a single GFlowNet (Bengio et al., 2021a;b) called JSP-GFN (for Joint Structure and Parameters GFlowNet).

extractions.description: The paper introduces JSP-GFN, a method that uses Generative Flow Networks to infer the joint posterior distribution over Bayesian Network structures and parameters. This approach provides flexibility for complex models and compares favorably with existing methods.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily deals with the computational methods for Bayesian Network structure learning using Generative Flow Networks, without a central focus or application in areas directly related to climate or sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We propose to infer the joint posterior over graphical structures G and parameters of the conditional probability distributions θ of a Bayesian Network using a single GFlowNet (Bengio et al., 2021a;b).
